preconditions.expression: isinstance(T, int) and T >= 1 and T <= 10000
preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S, str) and S.islower() and S.isalpha() and 1 <= len(S) <= 1000000 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string S consists only of lowercase English alphabets and has a length between 1 and 1,000,000.
The sum of lengths of all strings S across all test cases does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda i, S: int(output_lines[i]) == max_len(S)) for i, S in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case i with string S, the output line i is the maximum length of a valid substring P, or -1 if no such P exists.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda S: (int(output_lines[test_cases.index(S)]) == -1) or (int(output_lines[test_cases.index(S)]) == max((len(P) for P in valid_substrings(S))))) for S in test_cases)
postconditions.description: If a valid string P exists, the output is the maximum length among all valid P; otherwise, it is -1. A string P is valid if it is a non-empty substring of S, and no non-empty substring of P is a prefix of S, and no non-empty substring of P is a suffix of S.
